newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura's trading share smallest among Big 4 - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Nomura's trading share smallest among Big 4 - Jiji.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd's trading share on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) in April shrunk to 6.29 percent, the smallest amongst Japan's top four securities houses, Jiji news agency reported on Friday.

Jiji quoted market sources as saying Nomura Securities fell from top place in terms of trading share on the TSE to second in March following revelations of a scandal involving suspected illegal deals linked to a racketeer.
In March the trading market share of Nomura, Japan's largest brokerage, was 9.2 percent.
"It is still uncertain how harsh financial authorities may penalise Nomura," Jiji quoted one market source as saying.
Foreign securities houses appear to have benefited from Nomura's loss, Jiji said, as the market shares of the other large Japanese brokers on the TSE did not rise much in April.
Daiwa Securities Co Ltd took top place in April for the second consecutive month with a 10.75 percent market share, market sources told Jiji.
Nikko Securities Co Ltd came second with a 7.99 percent share and Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd was third with 7.20 percent, Jiji said.
